title: Privacy
intro: At Reel Sphere, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. We collect only what is necessary to improve your experience and ensure our services run smoothly. Your data is never sold or misused, and we apply appropriate security measures to keep it safe. By using our platform, you can trust that your information is handled with care and transparency.

commitment.title: Privacy & Trust Commitment
commitment.paragraph1: This Privacy Policy explains how your personal information is collected, used, and protected when you interact with the Archive. We value transparency as the foundation of trust, reflecting the clarity and care of a restored 35mm film.
commitment.paragraph2: We commit to never monetizing your personal browsing habits or selling your archival journey to third-party advertisers. Your interaction with our collection remains between you and the screen.

device.title: Device Information
device.description: We automatically collect certain information about your device, including web browser details, IP address, and time zone.

personal.title: Personal Identifiers
personal.description: When you subscribe to the Archive, we collect your name, email address, and cinematic preferences to curate your experience.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We use "Cookies" to record session information and provide a seamless navigation through our digital galleries.

curation.title: Curation
curation.description: We use your viewing history to suggest archival pieces that align with your historical interests and aesthetic tastes.

preservation.title: Preservation
preservation.description: Aggregated data helps us understand which eras of cinema require the most urgent digital restoration efforts.

communication.title: Communication
communication.description: To provide you with updates regarding new additions to the Archive or changes to our cinematic programming.

security.title: Security
security.description: To screen for potential risk or fraud and to ensure the integrity of our digital heritage vault.

dataRights.title: Your Data Rights
dataRights.description: You have the right to access personal information we hold about you and to ask that your personal information be corrected, updated, or deleted. If you would like to exercise this right, please contact us through the information below.

securityStandard.title: Security Standard
securityStandard.description: All transactions and data exchanges are protected using 256-bit SSL encryption, ensuring your heritage is preserved securely.
